# /graphify

Turn any folder of files into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection, an honest audit trail, and three outputs: interactive HTML, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and a plain-language GRAPH_REPORT.md.

## Usage

```
/graphify                                             # full pipeline on current directory (HTML viz; add --obsidian for a vault)
/graphify <path>                                      # full pipeline on specific path
/graphify https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>           # clone repo then run full pipeline on it
/graphify https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> --branch <branch>  # clone a specific branch
/graphify <url1> <url2> ...                           # clone multiple repos, build each, merge into one cross-repo graph
/graphify <path> --mode deep                          # thorough extraction, richer INFERRED edges
/graphify <path> --update                             # incremental - re-extract only new/changed files
/graphify <path> --directed                            # build directed graph (preserves edge direction: sourceâ†’target)
/graphify <path> --whisper-model medium                # use a larger Whisper model for better transcription accuracy
/graphify <path> --cluster-only                       # rerun clustering on existing graph
/graphify <path> --no-viz                             # skip visualization, just report + JSON
/graphify <path> --html                               # (HTML is generated by default - this flag is a no-op)
/graphify <path> --svg                                # also export graph.svg (embeds in Notion, GitHub)
/graphify <path> --graphml                            # export graph.graphml (Gephi, yEd)
/graphify <path> --neo4j                              # generate graphify-out/cypher.txt for Neo4j
/graphify <path> --neo4j-push bolt://localhost:7687   # push directly to Neo4j
/graphify <path> --falkordb                           # generate graphify-out/cypher.txt for FalkorDB
/graphify <path> --falkordb-push falkordb://localhost:6379   # push directly to FalkorDB
/graphify <path> --mcp                                # start MCP stdio server for agent access
/graphify <path> --watch                              # watch folder, auto-rebuild on code changes (no LLM needed)
/graphify <path> --wiki                               # build agent-crawlable wiki (index.md + one article per community)
/graphify <path> --obsidian --obsidian-dir ~/vaults/my-project  # write vault to custom path (e.g. existing vault)
/graphify add <url>                                   # fetch URL, save to ./raw, update graph
/graphify add <url> --author "Name"                   # tag who wrote it
/graphify add <url> --contributor "Name"              # tag who added it to the corpus
/graphify query "<question>"                          # BFS traversal - broad context
/graphify query "<question>" --dfs                    # DFS - trace a specific path
/graphify query "<question>" --budget 1500            # cap answer at N tokens
/graphify path "AuthModule" "Database"                # shortest path between two concepts
/graphify explain "SwinTransformer"                   # plain-language explanation of a node
```

## What graphify is for

Drop any folder of code, docs, papers, images, or video into graphify and get a queryable knowledge graph. Persistent across sessions, honest audit trail (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS), community detection surfaces cross-document connections you wouldn't think to ask about.

## What You Must Do When Invoked

If the user invoked `/graphify --help` or `/graphify -h` (with no other arguments), print the contents of the `## Usage` section above verbatim and stop. Do not run any commands, do not detect files, do not default the path to `.`. Just print the Usage block and return.

**Fast path â€” existing graph:** Before doing anything else, check whether `graphify-out/graph.json` exists. The expected location is `graphify-out/graph.json` relative to the **current working directory** (i.e. the project root where you are running commands). If it exists AND the user's request is a natural-language question about the codebase (e.g. "How does X work?", "What calls Y?", "Trace the data flow through Z") and NOT an explicit rebuild command (`--update`, `--cluster-only`, or a bare path/URL that implies fresh extraction): **skip Steps 1â€“5 entirely and jump straight to `## For /graphify query`.** Run `graphify query "<question>"` immediately. Do not run detect. Do not check corpus size. Do not ask the user to narrow. The graph is already built â€” use it.

If no path was given, use `.` (current directory). Do not ask the user for a path.

If the path argument starts with `https://github.com/` or `http://github.com/`, treat it as a GitHub URL - run Step 0 before anything else, then continue with the resolved local path.

Follow these steps in order. Do not skip steps.

### Step 0 - GitHub repos and multi-path merge (only if a URL or several paths)

Only when the path is one or more `https://github.com/...` URLs, or several local subfolders to merge. See `references/github-and-merge.md` for the clone, cross-repo merge, and monorepo flow, then continue with the resolved local path. A plain local path skips this step.

  docs:     N files (.md .txt ...)

### Step 2.5 - Video and audio (only if video files detected)

Skip this step entirely if `detect` returned zero `video` files. When the corpus has video or audio, see `references/transcribe.md` to transcribe them to text first, then treat the transcripts as doc files in Step 3.

### Step 3 - Extract entities and relationships

**Before starting:** note whether `--mode deep` was given. You must pass `DEEP_MODE=true` to every subagent in Step B2 if it was. Track this from the original invocation - do not lose it.

This step has two parts: **structural extraction** (deterministic, free) and **semantic extraction** (LLM, costs tokens).

Never ask the user for one, and never block on one.** Code is extracted structurally (AST) with no LLM and no key at all â€” a code-only corpus (the common `/graphify .` on a repo) skips semantic extraction entirely, so it needs nothing here: go straight to Part A and skip Part B. Semantic extraction (only for docs, papers, and images) uses Gemini **only if** `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`GOOGLE_API_KEY` is already set; otherwise the host agent itself is the LLM. graphify does **not** read `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or any other provider key. If you catch yourself about to prompt for, wait on, or stop because of a missing API key, that is a misread of this skill â€” proceed without one.

**Before semantic extraction:** check whether `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY` is set. If neither is set, print this one-liner to the user:

    Path('graphify-out/.graphify_ast.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")

 137 def corroborate(record, ledger, journal, server, task_exists=None, operation_owner=None):
 138     """The record's own `completed` is never reported on its own word (review round 1, OPS-1). A harness execution
 139     is `completed` only while the ledger says COMPLETE, the journal says `verified` and the server, when it answers,
 140     says `reply`; a local (no-task) execution only while the server answers `reply`. Anything less is reported as
 141     `uncertain` with the exact gap, the recorded state kept beside it. `server=None` means "not consulted" (listing);
 142     an unreachable server is a gap for a local execution and a non-contradiction for a harness one.
 143     -> (state, reason, corroboration dict)."""
 144     recorded = record.get("state")
 145     if recorded != "completed":
 146         return recorded, record.get("reason"), {"checked": False}
 147     gaps = []
 148     task_id = record.get("task_id")
 149     # Every execution (harness or local) ran under exactly one ticket operation; the worker claimed that operation for
 150     # this execution id when the ticket verified (create-once index). A record that names no operation, another
 151     # record's operation, or an operation this record never claimed is not corroborated (review round 4, OPS-1R).
 152     op = record.get("operation_id")
 153     if not isinstance(op, str) or not op:
 154         gaps.append("OPERATION_MISSING")
 155     else:
 156         owner = operation_owner(op) if operation_owner is not None else None
 157         if owner != record.get("execution_id"):
 158             gaps.append("OPERATION_NOT_OWNED")
 159         if task_id and task_id != op:
 160             gaps.append("OPERATION_TASK_MISMATCH")
 161         if isinstance(server, dict) and "error" not in server and server.get("operation_id") != op:
 162             gaps.append("SERVER_OPERATION_MISMATCH")
 163     if task_id:
 164         if not isinstance(ledger, dict) or (ledger.get("task") or {}).get("state") != "COMPLETE":
 165             gaps.append("LEDGER_NOT_COMPLETE")
 166         else:
 167             # The COMPLETE task must be THIS execution's: same turn, session, capability, selection and digests as the
 168             # record's proposal (a record pointing at another execution's finished task is not completed).
 169             req, prop = ledger.get("request") or {}, record.get("proposal") or {}
 170             if not isinstance(req, dict) or req.get("turn_id") != record.get("turn_id") or req.get("operation_id") != task_id \
 171                     or req.get("session_id") != record.get("session_id") \
 172                     or any(req.get(k) != prop.get(k) for k in ("session_id", "capability_id", "provider", "model",
 173                                                                "approval_digest", "argument_digest")):
 174                 gaps.append("LEDGER_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
 175             # The ledger row names the ONE execution record the bridge ran for (review round 2, OPS-1R): a second
 176             # record copying every field of a genuine execution is still not that execution.
 177             if isinstance(req, dict) and req.get("execution_id") != record.get("execution_id"):
 178                 gaps.append("LEDGER_EXECUTION_MISMATCH")
 179         if isinstance(server, dict) and "error" not in server:

 182             if server.get("session_id") != record.get("session_id"):
 183                 gaps.append("SERVER_SESSION_MISMATCH")
 184     else:
 185         prop = record.get("proposal") or {}
 186         if prop.get("kind") == "client_external_harness":
 187             gaps.append("TASK_OMITTED")                   # a harness execution without its supervisor task (OPS-1R)
 188         if server is None or not isinstance(server, dict) or "error" in server:
 189             gaps.append("SERVER_UNAVAILABLE")
 190         else:
 191             if server.get("state") != "reply":
 192                 gaps.append("SERVER_TURN_NOT_REPLY")
 193             if server.get("session_id") != record.get("session_id") or prop.get("session_id") != record.get("session_id"):
 194                 gaps.append("SERVER_SESSION_MISMATCH")

 266 
 267     def __init__(self, client_root):
 268         self.root = Path(client_root).resolve()
 269         self.dir = self.root / "control" / "supervisor" / "executions"
 270         self.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 271         self._lock = threading.RLock()
 272 
 273     def path(self, execution_id) -> Path:
 274         if not isinstance(execution_id, str) or not _ID.fullmatch(execution_id):
 275             raise TurnError("EXECUTION_ID_INVALID")
 276         return self.dir / (execution_id + ".json")
 277 
 278     # ---- operation ownership (review round 4, OPS-1R residual) -------------------------------------
 279     def _op_path(self, operation_id) -> Path | None:
 280         if not isinstance(operation_id, str) or not _OP_ID.fullmatch(operation_id):
 281             return None
 282         return self.dir / "operations" / (operation_id + ".json")
 283 
 284     def claim_operation(self, operation_id, execution_id):
 285         """First writer wins: the execution that verified the ticket for `operation_id` owns it for ever. Returns the
 286         owning execution id (this one, or an earlier claimant), or None when the id is not an operation id."""
 287         import json
 288         p = self._op_path(operation_id)
 289         if p is None:
 290             return None
 291         p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 292         with self._lock:
 293             try:
 294                 with open(p, "x", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 295                     json.dump({"operation_id": operation_id, "execution_id": execution_id, "claimed_at": _now()}, f)
 296                     f.flush()
 297                     import os
 298                     os.fsync(f.fileno())
 299             except FileExistsError:
 300                 pass
 301         return self.operation_owner(operation_id)
 302 
 303     def operation_owner(self, operation_id):
 304         import json
 305         p = self._op_path(operation_id)
 306         if p is None or not p.is_file():
 307             return None
 308         try:
 309             data = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 310         except (OSError, ValueError):
 311             return None
 312         owner = data.get("execution_id") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
 313         return owner if isinstance(owner, str) and _ID.fullmatch(owner) and data.get("operation_id") == operation_id else None
 314 
 315     def get(self, execution_id):
 316         import json
 317         p = self.path(execution_id)
 318         with self._lock:
 319             if not p.is_file():
 320                 return None
 321             try:
 322                 rec = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 323             except (OSError, ValueError):
 324                 return {"schema": SCHEMA, "execution_id": execution_id, "state": "uncertain", "reason": "RECORD_UNREADABLE"}
 325         # Valid JSON is not yet a valid record (review round 1 OPS-2, round 2 OPS-2R): the id must be the file's and
 326         # every field the worker reads must have its type. Anything else is an uncertain stub, so listing and restart
 327         # reconciliation never abort on one damaged row.
 328         if not _well_typed(rec, execution_id):
 329             return {"schema": SCHEMA, "execution_id": execution_id, "state": "uncertain", "reason": "RECORD_SCHEMA"}
 330         return rec

 332     def write(self, record):
 333         with self._lock:
 334             atomic_json(self.path(record["execution_id"]), record)

 336     def update(self, execution_id, **fields):
 337         with self._lock:
 338             rec = self.get(execution_id)
 339             if rec is None:
 340                 raise TurnError("EXECUTION_UNKNOWN")
 341             rec.update(fields)
 342             rec["updated_at"] = _now()
 343             self.write(rec)

 346     def list(self, limit=_LIST_LIMIT):
 347         with self._lock:
 348             ids = sorted(p.stem for p in self.dir.glob("*.json") if _ID.fullmatch(p.stem))
 349             recs = [self.get(i) for i in ids]
 350         recs = [r for r in recs if r is not None]
 351         recs.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("queued_at") or 0, r["execution_id"]), reverse=True)
 352         return recs[:limit]
 353 
 354     def reconcile_restart(self, ledger_path, why="WORKER_RESTARTED"):
 355         """Every non-terminal record belongs to a worker that is gone: the attempt (if any) was killed by its
 356         kill-on-close job and the bridge has revoked the task's authority. The record becomes `uncertain`; the ledger
 357         facts are attached. Nothing is re-launched."""
 358         out = []
 359         for rec in self.list(limit=10_000):
 360             if rec.get("state") in TERMINAL_STATES:
 361                 continue
 362             view = ledger_view(ledger_path, rec.get("task_id"))
 363             self.update(rec["execution_id"], state="uncertain", reason=why, ended_at=_now(), restart_ledger=view,
 364                         previous_state=rec.get("state"))
 365             out.append({"execution_id": rec["execution_id"], "was": rec.get("state"), "state": "uncertain", "reason": why})
 366         return out

 369 class ExecutionController:
 370     """Worker-side lifecycle driver. `service` is the SupervisedWorkerService that owns the pending turns and the
 371     runner; `bridge` the SupervisorBridge whose `cancel` kills running attempts."""
 372 
 373     def __init__(self, service, client_root, *, bridge, composition=None, server_status=None, clock=None):
 374         self.service, self.bridge, self.composition = service, bridge, composition
 375         self.clock = clock or _now
 376         self.root = Path(client_root).resolve()
 377         self.register = ExecutionRegister(self.root)
 378         self.ledger_path = self.root / "control" / "supervisor" / "ledger.db"
 379         self.journal_path = self.root / "control" / "execution-journal.sqlite3"
 380         self._server_status = server_status
 381         self._lock = threading.Lock()
 382         self._active = None
 383         self._thread = None
 384         self._cancel = set()
 385         self._task = {}
 386         self.startup = self._reconcile_on_start()
 387 
 388     # ---- start-up -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 389     def _reconcile_on_start(self):
 390         journal = None
 391         if self.journal_path.is_file():
 392             try:
 393                 # Frozen rule (C4 journal): after a restart every claimed operation is uncertain until reconciled.
 394                 journal = [o for o in ExecutionJournal(self.root).recover() if o["state"] == "execution_uncertain"]
 395             except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001  (reported, never hidden; the register still reconciles)
 396                 journal = {"error": "JOURNAL_RECOVER_FAILED:" + type(exc).__name__}
 397         return {"journal": journal, "executions": self.register.reconcile_restart(self.ledger_path)}
 398 
 399     # ---- queries ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 400     @property
 401     def active(self):
 402         with self._lock:
 403             return self._active
 404 
 405     def qualification_of(self, provider, kind="client_external_harness"):
 406         """Qualification row for a harness provider; None for non-harness rows (the deterministic local row)."""
 407         if self.composition is None or not provider or kind != "client_external_harness":
 408             return None
 409         for row in self.composition.report:
 410             if row.get("provider") == provider:
 411                 keys = ("status", "reason", "level", "models", "version", "expires_at", "qualified_at", "executable_sha256")
 412                 return {k: row.get(k) for k in keys}
 413         return {"status": "NOT_QUALIFIED", "reason": "NO_RECORD"}
 414 
 415     def proposal(self, turn_id):
 416         entry = self.service.pending.get(turn_id)
 417         if entry is None:
 418             raise TurnError("TURN_NOT_PENDING")
 419         _, session, reasoning, turn = entry
 420         return execution_proposal(self.service.manifest.data["client_id"], session, turn_id, reasoning,
 421                                   turn.get("approval_request"), self.qualification_of(reasoning.get("provider"), reasoning.get("kind")))
 422 
 423     def status(self, execution_id):
 424         rec = self.register.get(execution_id)
 425         if rec is None:
 426             raise TurnError("EXECUTION_UNKNOWN")
 427         task_id, op = rec.get("task_id"), rec.get("operation_id")
 428         ledger, journal = ledger_view(self.ledger_path, task_id), journal_view(self.journal_path, op if isinstance(op, str) else task_id)
 429         server = self._server_turn(rec.get("turn_id"))
 430         state, reason, corroboration = corroborate(rec, ledger, journal, server, self._task_exists, self.register.operation_owner)

507     def _run(self, eid, text, session, reasoning, turn):
 508         runner = None
 509         try:
 510             runner = self.service._runner()
 511             approve = not self._cancel_requested(eid)
 512             self.register.update(eid, state="approving", approving_at=self.clock(), decision="approve" if approve else "deny")
 513 
 514             def on_dispatch(work):
 515                 with self._lock:
 516                     self._task[eid] = work.task_id
 517                     cancelled = eid in self._cancel
 518                 self.register.update(eid, task_id=work.task_id, state="running", running_at=self.clock())
 519                 if cancelled:
 520                     self.bridge.cancel(work.task_id)          # arrived between approval and dispatch: never spawns
 521 
 522             def on_outcome(work, outcome, evidence, failure):
 523                 public = [{k: e.get(k) for k in ("check", "matched", "output_sha256", "output_bytes", "harness",
 524                                                   "supervisor_task", "supervisor_attempt", "basis")}
 525                           for e in (evidence or []) if isinstance(e, dict)]
 526                 self.register.update(eid, bridge_outcome=outcome, failure_category=failure, evidence=public)
 527 
 528             def on_starting(operation_id):
 529                 owner = self.register.claim_operation(operation_id, eid)      # create-once: first execution wins
 530                 self.register.update(eid, state="starting", starting_at=self.clock(), operation_id=operation_id, operation_owner=owner)
 531 
 532             runner.on_dispatch, runner.on_outcome, runner.on_starting = on_dispatch, on_outcome, on_starting
 533             runner.dispatch_context = {"execution_id": eid}       # the bridge records it in the ledger task row
 534             final = runner.decide(text, session, reasoning, turn, approve)
 535             rec = self.register.get(eid)
 536             state, reason = self._classify(final, rec, approve)
 537             self.register.update(eid, state=state, reason=reason, code=final.get("code"), message=final.get("message"),
 538                                  server_state=final.get("state"), ended_at=self.clock())
 539         except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
 540             code = str(getattr(exc, "code", type(exc).__name__))[:96]
 541             rec = self.register.get(eid) or {}
 542             # Nothing was sent to the server while `queued`; afterwards the approval, claim or settle may have landed.
 543             state = "failed" if rec.get("state") == "queued" else "uncertain"
 544             self.register.update(eid, state=state, reason="EXCEPTION:" + code, ended_at=self.clock())
 545         finally:
 546             if runner is not None:
 547                 runner.on_dispatch = runner.on_outcome = runner.on_starting = runner.dispatch_context = None
 548             with self._lock:
 549                 if self._active == eid:
 550                     self._active = None
 551                 self._task.pop(eid, None)
 552                 self._cancel.discard(eid)
 553 
 554     @staticmethod
 555     def _classify(final, rec, approve):
 556         code = final.get("code") if isinstance(final, dict) else None
 557         failure = (rec or {}).get("failure_category") or ""
 558         cancel = bool((rec or {}).get("cancel_requested")) or not approve
 559         if code == "SETTLED_VERIFIED":
 560             return "completed", None
 561         if code == "APPROVAL_DENIED":
 562             return "cancelled", "CANCELLED_BEFORE_APPROVAL" if cancel else "DECLINED"
 563         if code == "WAITING_FOR_MODEL":
 564             return "quota_paused", "PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED"
 565         if code == "SETTLED_EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN":
 566             return "uncertain", ("CANCELLED_AFTER_DISPATCH" if cancel and failure.startswith("CANCELLED_AFTER_DISPATCH") else failure or code)
 567         if code == "SETTLED_FAILED":
 568             if cancel and failure == NOT_STARTED + "CANCELLED":
 569                 return "cancelled", "CANCELLED_BEFORE_START"
 570             return "failed", failure or code
 571         return "uncertain", "UNRECOGNISED_SETTLEMENT:" + str(code)[:64]
 572 
 573     # ---- cancel ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 574     def cancel(self, execution_id):
 575         with self._lock:
 576             rec = self.register.get(execution_id)
 577             if rec is None:
 578                 raise TurnError("EXECUTION_UNKNOWN")
 579             if rec.get("state") in TERMINAL_STATES:
 580                 raise TurnError("EXECUTION_TERMINAL")
 581             if self._active != execution_id:
 582                 raise TurnError("EXECUTION_NOT_OWNED")       # a record from an earlier worker; restart reconciliation owns it
 583             self._cancel.add(execution_id)
 584             task = self._task.get(execution_id)
 585         self.register.update(execution_id, cancel_requested=True, cancel_requested_at=self.clock())
 586         kill = self.bridge.cancel(task)["kill"] if task else {"granted": False, "reason": "NOT_DISPATCHED"}
 587         return {"execution_id": execution_id, "cancel": "requested", "kill": kill, "state": self.register.get(execution_id)["state"]}
 588 
 589     # ---- shutdown ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 590     def close(self, timeout_s=30.0):
 591         """The owning worker is going away: withdraw the active execution (kill through the job) and wait, bounded,
 592         for its settlement so the record is terminal. The kill-on-close job covers whatever is left."""
 593         eid = self.active
 594         if eid is None:
 595             return {"active": None}
 596         try:
 597             self.cancel(eid)
 598         except TurnError as exc:
 599             return {"active": eid, "cancel": str(exc.code)}
 600         t = self._thread
 601         if t is not None:
 602             t.join(timeout_s)
 603         rec = self.register.get(eid) or {}
 604         if rec.get("state") not in TERMINAL_STATES:
 605             self.register.update(eid, state="uncertain", reason="WORKER_CLOSED_DURING_EXECUTION", ended_at=self.clock())
 606         return {"active": eid, "state": self.register.get(eid)["state"]}
